scope: Compile the one embedded Mortise headless Agent/RPC entrypoint into an immutable target-platform executable.
hardConstraints: One executable producer and one runtime entrypoint
No JavaScript fallback or bundled interactive product surface
Target-platform executable hash is bound to the immutable source/build manifest
Works with the repository's existing TypeScript and Bun build graph
selectionRule: Choose the highest-ranked non-archived candidate that consumes the existing source graph directly and preserves OPT-017 manifest/hash provenance without a second injection or staging authority.
discoveryStop: Stopped after the current compiler, the platform runtime's official single-executable facility, and the previously common archived packager covered the materially plausible local executable strategies.
